origin: hand-written from the published schema; every value invented
notes: With group_by=workspace each row is split per workspace and carries workspace_id. Without that parameter rows are aggregated across workspaces and workspace_id is NOT returned, which preserves the historical response shape - so a parser must treat workspace_id as optional and must not assume one row per date. Activity recorded before workspace resolution existed is permanently attributed to the account default workspace; the provider states no backfill is possible, which is a coverage gap an adapter has to report rather than paper over.
